about: Live zone phase 3, step 1 (docs/ZONE-CLIENT-CONTRACT.md): the page side of shared boss health. Every number, route, class and action of src/zone/shared-hp-client.ts and src/zone/shared-hp-chunk.ts is a row here; the weapon caps are NOT here, they are data/zone-server-rules.json weapons x progression.maxDamageMult (one source for the phone and the database). OFF unless the link has ?sharedhp=1 (this page's own host at `path`) or ?sharedhp=http(s)://host[:port][/path] (exactly that writer, but ONLY when that host is this page's own host or is listed in `hosts`, host[:port], default none: a link cannot aim the client's fetch at an arbitrary host); with no ?sharedhp= nothing is fetched and nothing runs. `timing`: tickMs is how often the chunk's driver calls the client's tick; flushMs the shortest gap between two hit batches; stateMs how often the shared hp is read back; touchMs how long a fighting-but-not-swinging phone waits before a heartbeat (the token lives engage.ttlS = 120 s); timeoutMs the longest one call may take before the transport reports a timeout; engageRetryMs the wait before an engage is asked again after a lost one. `sim`: the sim event the claim is built from (a Hit whose actor is the hero side and whose target is the foe side). `batch`: a batch id is idPrefix + idSep + the page's session + idSep + a counter that only goes up (the server's pattern ids.batchIdPattern decides what is legal); a spent id is never sent twice. `backoff`: after a failed whole call every channel waits baseMs x factor^(n-1), at most maxMs; offlineAfter consecutive failures mark the bar stale (the sim's own bar stays the truth). `engageRetry`: a LOST engage (an error the tables answer with lost, or no row at all) is asked again after engageRetryMs x factor^(n-1), at most maxMs, and after maxTries in a row the client stops sharing (the sim's own bar stays the truth); a status in stopStatus (any 4xx except 408 timeout, 425 too early and 429 rate limit, which can pass) is not asked again at all. `kill`: how often and how many times the idempotent kill_report is read for the credit, and the two answer states that end it (settled: the server paid or floored this account; unpaid: the life ended with no credit row for it; any other state, `alive`, is read again). `refusals` map the server's refusal ids (data/zone-server-rules.json refusals; a test pins every id has a row) to an action; `sqlClasses` map an error code (a SQLSTATE or a custom O-code, matched by PREFIX, first row wins) to an action; `transportClasses` map a whole-call failure (kind, or an HTTP status range) to an action; `fallback` is the action for a code or failure no row names. Actions are a closed set: lost (this row's damage is gone, nothing else), reengage (drop the token, engage again after delayMs or engageRetryMs), dead (the boss is dead: wait for the respawn), backoff (lost, and every channel waits; counts toward the stale bar), wait (every channel waits baseMs, but the server DID answer, so it is not a failure and never marks the bar stale), stop (stop sharing this boss; the sim's own bar stays the truth), block (never claim this weapon again this session).
